verdict.rationale: Opting out of analytics or usage tracking (for example through cookie or analytics consent controls) is a fair question for a government web portal, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing about telemetry, cookies or tracking opt-out. The closest item is managing communication-reception channels, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
